cases.expected: If the mirrored ATS/Gmail session cookie expires mid-run, pause, prompt human re-auth in visible Chrome, and re-sync cookies.

cases.note: SQLite lease acquisition is strictly local on the host machine.
Proposal Section 2.1 sets PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000 and 120s TTL stale lock scavenger.

cases.expected: If SQLite WAL is corrupted or read-only, surface a clear diagnostic error instead of bypassing mutual exclusion.

cases.note: Single atomic SQLite INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE transaction.
CAS WHERE expires_at < now checks lease freshness atomically at write time.
Cookie cloning reads local Chrome profile SQLite files.

cases.expected: If macOS Keychain modal hangs waiting for user approval, time out after 30s and offer ephemeral profile fallback.
If Chrome holds a file lock on Default/Cookies, copy the WAL/DB snapshot or retry instead of failing cookie sync.

cases.note: Each worker gets a unique ephemeral directory ~/.shadowmux/profiles/shadow_worker_<uuid>.

cases.expected: If cookies copy succeeds but LocalStorage/IndexedDB fails, warn and re-auth cleanly rather than running half-authenticated.
If the human refreshes a session in visible Chrome while agent is queued, re-clone cookies after lease acquisition.
On network drop, save DOM checkpoint, release domain lease cleanly, and notify caller.
Enforce per-task max execution deadline distinct from heartbeat renewals so a hung page cannot renew leases forever.

cases.note: Lease release and audit logging are local SQLite operations.

cases.expected: Retry release with exponential backoff and verify owner token match before leaving a domain locked.
Kill orphaned Chrome CDP PID if release fails, so zombie workers cannot keep mutating the domain after TTL expiry.

cases.note: Lease deletion/release is keyed by signed token.

cases.expected: Release SQLite lease and write SHA-256 audit row in one atomic transaction.
If TTL expired while paused for human and another owner took the lease, reject release on token mismatch instead of deleting someone else's lock.

cases.title: Lease TTL (120s) expires while PAUSED_FOR_HUMAN
